$control¶

Job type, level of theory, basis-set file, Hamiltonian and printing.

task¶

Type: enum
Default: gradient
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf (default gradient, check); 02 §3.2 (pri: default gradient); 03 §5; 04 #69-#73, #145, #478, #497; 01 §4.2; 08 t02, t18, t26, t34, t36, t37; 09; 08 t50, t57a

Job type.

Value

Meaning

energy

Energy at the given geometry.

gradient

Energy and nuclear gradient. Costs little more than the energy. (default)

hessian

Second derivatives (force constants) followed by vibrational analysis and thermochemistry.

optimize

Geometry optimization, including saddle points with $optimize saddle=1.

optimize+hessian

Optimization followed by a Hessian at the final geometry. The only combined task that works. Present in v2 and v9 and later, absent in v6.

irc

Intrinsic reaction coordinate. Needs a Hessian at the TS in the input ($Energy). Each point is printed on IRC> lines with its distance and energy.

scan

Relaxed potential-energy-surface scan over the coordinates in $optimize fix. The structures and energies are summarized on SCAN> lines at the end.

nmr

NMR shielding tensors. Works only with theory=dft: with ridft, version 25 silently runs only the ground-state SCF.

dipole

Numerical dipole polarizabilities and their derivatives with respect to nuclear coordinates (used for Raman intensities), from SCF runs in finite electric fields. The result is a num> block.

check

Not a task name in the version 25 program. Like any unrecognized task, task=check sets up the run (geometry, basis sets, SCF and grid settings) and stops before the SCF without a message, which makes it a usable input check. (undocumented)

extremal

Gradient-extremal path (v9 banner “Calculation of Gradient Extremal Path”); slow. (undocumented)

transit

Synchronous transit in internal coordinates. Needs two $molecule blocks (start and end). Reported working in v8. (undocumented)

saddle

Approximate saddle-point search from two $molecule blocks (start and end). (undocumented)

path

Minimum-energy-path optimization from two $molecule blocks (start and end). (undocumented)

conical

Conical intersection of states 0 and 1 (v9 banner). Untested. (undocumented)

anharmonic

Anharmonic corrections to vibrational energies; slow. (undocumented)

opt_n1

Optimizer for very large systems (used for 8060 atoms with theory=qm_n2). Pairs with $optimize mod=1. (undocumented)

thermostat

Molecular dynamics with a thermostat; see $dynamic. Ran with every tested theory in version 25. (undocumented)

uniq

Filter duplicate structures among several $molecule blocks; see $uniq. (undocumented)

Note

Two task= lines do not chain jobs: only the first one runs. Apart from optimize+hessian, sequences such as optimize→NMR need separate runs or an external driver script. A misspelled task name gives no error: version 25 sets up the run and stops quietly, as for check. task=critical does not work; density critical points come from print=+density. task=QM appears only in the header of the shipped qm.in parameter file and is not a user task. The binary contains further task words (IRC4, PATHX, PATHR, STERIC, POLARIZABILITY, MMDYNAMIC, and others) that are untested or need data that is not distributed.

See also: saddle ($optimize), points ($optimize), print ($control)

theory¶

Type: enum
Default: dft
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf (default dft); 06 §3 (v5 ab initio list); 03 §5 (Evgeniy 2011 test); 04 #96, #99, #307-#310; 01 §3.1, §4.2; 08 t02, t08, t17, t31-t33, t38, t39, t46; 08 t50b

Theoretical method.

Value

Meaning

dft

GGA DFT with density fitting. Hybrid functionals are not applied here: see notes. (default)

ridft

Hybrid DFT with exact exchange via the resolution-of-identity (RI) approximation. Required for hybrid functionals; the default functional is then PBE1. Hessians are numerical.

DFT_n4

Newer DFT variant, used in the official example inputs with func=LPBEVV (2025). Runs in version 25 (summary box: DFT_N4); what it changes is not documented. (undocumented)

tddft

GGA time-dependent DFT (no hybrid TDDFT).

rimp2

RI-MP2. Hessians are numerical.

hf

Hartree–Fock.

rihf

RI Hartree–Fock.

cis

CIS (RHF/UHF). Prints a table of excited states; E = is the total energy of the first excited state. Slow and disk-hungry.

mp2

Conventional MP2 (RHF, UHF, ROHF). Very disk-hungry.

mp3

MP3.

mp4dq

MP4(DQ).

mp4sdq

MP4(SDQ).

mp4sdtq

MP4(SDTQ) (RHF).

ccs

CCS. With an HF reference it returns the HF energy.

ccd

CCD.

ccsd

CCSD (RHF/UHF).

ccsd4t

CCSD(T).

ccsdsd

CCSD for an excited state, closed-shell (RHF) only; the state is chosen with state=, as for cis and tddft. Version 25 first solves CCSD for the ground state, then the excited state, and reports the excited state’s total energy in eng>. Without state= it gives the CCSD ground-state energy. For an open-shell molecule it silently stops after UHF (no CCSD, exit 0). Described as linear-response CCSD by the v5 keyword page. (undocumented)

qm_n3

Laikov’s semiempirical QM model. Needs basis=qm.in and no set=; parameters exist for H, Li–F, Na–Cl, Sc–Cu. Runs in version 25, with a short output of its own (no summary box, no E  = line). (undocumented)

qm_n2

Earlier variant of the QM model, used for very large systems with task=opt_n1. (undocumented)

Note

A misspelled theory name gives no error: version 25 prints it in the summary box and runs Hartree–Fock.

Hybrid trap. Hybrid functionals (PBE1, B3LYP, …) take effect only with theory=ridft. With theory=dft or tddft, older versions silently drop the exact exchange. In version 25, theory=dft stops right after printing the basis sets, with no error message in the output and exit status 1. theory=tddft still runs: it reports PBE1 in the summary box but leaves out the exact exchange, so the energies are wrong (water: Ex -6.61 instead of about -8.95 hartree, total energy about 2.2 hartree too high), and the run ends normally.

The ab initio list comes from the v6 documentation and a 2011 user test, which was energy-only. In version 25, water energies run to completion with hf, rihf, cis, mp2, mp3, mp4dq, mp4sdq, mp4sdtq, ccs, ccd, ccsd and ccsd4t; an hf optimization also worked, so HF gradients exist. For ridft and rimp2, task=hessian works by finite differences of the gradient (NUMERICAL COMPUTATION OF SECOND DERIVATIVES); for dft it is analytic. These were reported not working in v6: mp4, rimp4, rimp4sdtq, rimp4sdq, riccsd, riccsd4t. They either crash or return the HF energy. The binary contains many more method words (CASSCF, MRCISD, CCSDT, …); none has been reported working.

See also: functional ($dft)

state¶

Type: list
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 08 t33

For excited-state methods. The first value is the excited state n whose properties are computed; the second is the number of states N included in the iterative solution of the equations (state=n,N). In version 25, theory=tddft with state=1,5 printed all five states in an Electronic Spectrum: table (excitation energy, wavelength, transition moment, oscillator strength), and E  = was the total energy of state 1.

basis¶

Type: string
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf; 01 §4.11, §6; 03 §5; 04 §0; 08 t03

Default: basis-set data are read from the input file itself.

Name of the file containing the basis-set data (and ECPs, or QM parameters for qm.in). The name may be double-quoted, which is needed when the path contains special characters. Use straight quotes: typographic quotes break parsing.

Note

Shipped files include basis.in (Λ/L family, default set L1), basis4.in (scalar-relativistic L family; needs four=1), 3z.bas (DFT only, Z ≤ 54), sbk.bas (SBK ECPs, up to Z = 86), b2*.in, b2u*.in, b4s*.in, and qm.in. In version 25 a relative name such as basis=basis.in works when the file is in the directory the program is started from. An absolute path is still the safest choice for parallel and batch runs.

See also: set ($molecule), four ($control)

four¶

Type: switch
Default: 0
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 01 §3.3; 04 #207-#208, #336; 08 t35, t49

Four-component option.

Value

Meaning

0

Non-relativistic theory. (default)

1

Scalar-relativistic theory (K. G. Dyall, J. Chem. Phys. 100 (1994) 2118–2127). The output reports “Hamiltonian: scalar-relativistic”.

Note

Required with the relativistic basis file basis4.in. Without it, version 25 stops right after the Basis set input: line with 1?.

See also: nucleus ($control), d1small ($scf)

nucleus¶

Type: enum
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; 01 §4.2; 06 §1; 08 t35

Default: finite for four-component theory, point for non-relativistic theory.

Nuclear model. The official example inputs write it as nuc=finite.

Value

Meaning

finite

Gaussian nuclear model (L. Visscher, K. G. Dyall, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 67 (1997) 207–224).

point

Point-nucleus model.

Note

A basis optimized for a point nucleus must not be used with the finite-nucleus model, and vice versa. With four=1 and no nucleus=, version 25 prints Finite nucleus model (1): with the Gaussian parameters of each element.

See also: four ($control)

print¶

Type: flags
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf; 06 §3; 04 #376, #460, #498-#502, #509; 08 t01, t45

Printing options. Flags are appended one after another; + switches an option on and - switches it off. The leading + can be omitted (print=charges+bonds).

Value

Meaning

+charges

Hirshfeld charges (DFT methods), printed as “Atomic partitions of the density”. With theory=hf, version 25 stops after the SCF with 0: read 'Basis2' and exit 1.

+bonds

Mulliken populations and bond orders (SCF only), printed as “Overlap populations”.

+esr

ESR parameters.

+vectors

SCF vectors.

+molden

MOLDEN data: vibrations on freq> lines for task=hessian; with +vectors+molden also orbitals on mos> lines ([Molden Format], [Atoms] AU, [5D], [GTO], [MO] sections).

+density

Critical points of the electron density (QTAIM). Combine with +charges to label them. (undocumented)

-internals

Suppress the printout of internal coordinates. (undocumented)

Example:

$control print=+vectors+molden $end

derivative¶

Type: enum
Default: none stated
Status: undocumented · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: 09; 08 t53

Default: analytic second derivatives where the method has them (GGA DFT), numerical otherwise.

How task=hessian computes the second derivatives. Not in any written source; found in the program and tested in version 25, where derivative=numeric with theory=dft gave the same water frequencies as the analytic Hessian to within 0.2 cm⁻¹.

Value

Meaning

analytic

Analytic second derivatives.

numeric

Second derivatives by finite differences of the gradient (NUMERICAL COMPUTATION OF SECOND DERIVATIVES).

See also: steps ($d2edr2)

save¶

Type: string
Default: none stated
Status: current · verified on 25 (2025.02.28)
Sources: input.txt; Dft.rtf; 04 #306; 08 t27

File name for saving SCF vectors. With $guess read=1 the vectors are read back from the same file. This is the basis of the SCF restart technique. In version 25, a run with $guess read=1 prints Initial Guess (-1) and vectors from '<file>'; the normal guess is printed as Initial Guess (2).

See also: read ($guess)
